question: Which components and residual alternatives retain useful finite-precision behavior and learn under controlled depth and magnitude stress?
scope: Independent CPU FP32 stress suite. Keep the frozen early99 GPU queue and its selection unchanged. Numerical counterexamples are not spontaneous training failures. The residual learner is a SwiGLU residual network, not a full attention model or the early99 benchmark.
architecture: Peri-RMS + centered XSA + SwiGLU + SSMax + Q/K RMS + post-RMS 1/sqrt(2L) scaling + tied embedding/readout + parameter-free RMS including embedding RMS + Log-Scaled LeRoPE

components.reference: FP64 evaluation of the same quantized inputs/parameters with FP32 epsilon; rotary reference instead constructs the intended angle in FP64. FP64 is a numerical reference, not an arbitrary-precision trigonometric proof. Record norms, errors and finite flags separately.

residual_learning.data: Independent Gaussian vectors normalized to RMS one. A fixed random orthogonal R defines targets y=x+a*tanh(xR), at strengths a=0.25 and 1.0. All seeds, variants and depths share both fixed splits and R. No learned readout hides the residual task.
residual_learning.models: Every branch uses the same initialized bias-free SwiGLU F(RMS(h)). pre_unit adds the raw branch; peri_unit adds RMS(F); peri_sqrt adds RMS(F)/sqrt(D); peri_depth adds RMS(F)/D. peri_post_gate multiplies the peri_sqrt branch by 2*sigmoid(s), s=0. peri_pre_gate instead puts that gain inside output RMS. peri_rezero uses s/sqrt(D), s=0, after output RMS. These are isolated adaptations, not reproductions of entire ReZero or mHC training recipes. Gates add D scalar parameters; all original matrices and batch orders match.
residual_learning.measurement: Run every cell for all 512 updates unless a numerical failure occurs; observe full train/held-out relative MSE at step zero and every 32 updates. Relative MSE divides by mean squared teacher residual y-x on the same split. Record first <=0.05 crossing, final losses, hidden norms, gradient norms and final input-Jacobian singular values. Preserve all histories, checkpoints, optimizer state and fingerprints.
residual_learning.ranking: Rank by number of the 12 cells per variant reaching threshold. If all 12 pass, compare geometric-mean first-crossing updates. Otherwise compare worst final relative MSE across all 12 (nonfinite is worst); use median final error only as a tie-break. Report all seed/depth/strength regressions. Best means best among these declared small residual tests; it does not authorize replacing the main transformer. No retuning after outcomes.

sources.mhc: https://arxiv.org/html/2512.24880v2 ; local Transformer.MHC.Section4_Stability and Section4_Sinkhorn: fixed doubly-stochastic mixing is nonexpansive, may erase disagreement, and finite Sinkhorn is not exact double stochasticity.
sources.rezero: https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.04887 ; only the zero-initialized scalar residual-gate idea is adapted here, with retained Peri-RMS and fixed depth scaling.
sources.post_gate: Local adaptive_residual.py and residual_gradient_paths experiment; scalar 2*sigmoid gate here, rather than a new input-dependent projection row.
